Done — `routes/users.js:6` now emits `user_id` instead of `userId`. That was the only occurrence in the repo; no tests exist here to run.

One thing worth flagging before this ships: the README says `GET /users` field names are contract, with three consumers (web app, iOS 3.2+, nightly partner export), and that changes go through a versioned endpoint. This is a breaking change for any client reading `userId` — the iOS clients in particular can't be updated in lockstep. If you want it versioned instead, I can add a `/v2/users` and leave the existing response untouched.
